_arm_note: Non-HER counterpart to td3_jal_her_config.json. Run in parallel with `--base-port 7000` (or similar) so it doesn't collide with the HER run's simulator ports. Cannot load the HER warmup checkpoint (different policy class: MultiInputPolicy/Dict vs MlpPolicy/Box), so this arm trains its own warmup from scratch — that's what stage1_015_warm is for here.

stage1_015_warm.description: DISABLED (timesteps=0) — completed in 2026-05-19 14:10 run. Final: 70.6% goal rate over 1474 episodes, kick=100% (correct for ±15° spawn). Resuming from stage1_015_warm_complete.zip via top-level load_model. Re-enable only to redo warmup from scratch.

stage1_060_warm.description: DISABLED (timesteps=0). Same rationale as in the HER arm — ±60° spawn regime created a kick-100% local optimum. Skip to ±180° directly. Kept for reference / future iterations.

stage1_090_mid.description: ACTIVE (timesteps=50000). Intermediate stage between ±15° warmup and ±180° full. At ±90° spawn, 33% of spawn angles fail the cone gate (cos(theta) <= 0.5) and force the policy to turn before kicking — strong enough forcing function to bootstrap turn-then-kick behavior, but gentle enough that the remaining 67% of spawns still allow immediate kicks (preserving reward gradient from the warmup-learned aim habit). At ±60° (compared) 0% of spawns fail the cone, which is why the ±60° variant collapses to kick-100%. At ±180° (next stage) 67% of spawns fail, which is the harder consolidation regime. invalid_action_penalty bumped from 0.2 → 0.5 so cone-blocked kicks pay -0.5/step (kick-100% EV becomes -33 vs +30 for turn-then-kick — strict ordering breaks the kick-only attractor). Loads from end-of-stage1_015_warm in this same run (rebound + replay buffer reset).

stage1_120_mid.description: DISABLED (timesteps=0). Superseded by stage1_090_mid as the intermediate stage. Kept for reference.

stage1_180_full.description: ACTIVE (timesteps=150000). Full ±180° spawn theta consolidation. 67% of spawns fail the cone gate (require turn-first). alignment_weight=2.0 (delta-cos, has-ball gated) provides a per-step carrot for turning toward goal. invalid_action_penalty=0.5 same as stage1_090_mid. Loads from end-of-stage1_090_mid in this same run (trainer rebinds existing model into the new env and resets the replay buffer + step counters). Budget split: 50k mid + 150k full = 200k total post-warmup; the same total as the previous single-stage 200k full, just with a curriculum bridge.

stage1_9.description: DISABLED (timesteps=0). Re-enable after stage1_180_full completes; set timesteps>0 here and point top-level `load_model` at the final stage1_180_full checkpoint. Adds approach_ball to the action mask (1v0 approach + turn + kick).
